MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 33

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 30
   C. 90
   D. 42

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

5. What is √36? (1 mark)

   C. 6
   D. 18

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66

   C. 34
   D. 17

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.7

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

13. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

14. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

16. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 40.5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
